name: Angus McGregor
bio:
Angus McGregor is a seasoned PR professional with a passion for motorsport that ignited during his childhood spent trackside at local V8 Supercar races. After graduating with a degree in Communications, Angus honed his skills at a boutique PR agency specializing in sports marketing, before making the leap to motorsport full-time. He believes in crafting compelling narratives that resonate with fans and sponsors alike, always aiming to amplify the team's message and build a strong brand identity.

Known for his calm demeanor and creative thinking, Angus excels at managing media relations, developing innovative marketing campaigns, and navigating the fast-paced world of motorsport PR. He's particularly adept at crisis communications, ensuring the team maintains a positive image even under pressure. His dedication to perfection and a genuine love for the sport makes him a valuable asset to any team, and he's excited to bring his expertise to Vee Masters.

Angus is a firm believer in building lasting relationships with journalists, influencers, and fans. He's always willing to go the extra mile to ensure everyone has a positive experience with Vee Masters, and he's constantly looking for new and exciting ways to engage with the motorsport community.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Angus is a solidly built man with a friendly face and an approachable demeanor.
